# Honest Weight Loss Reviews

> Independent reviews of behaviour-change weight-loss apps and meal plans for adults in the United States (18+). No promises about results, no testimonials, no invented figures. Every price and trial term is checked against official pages or labelled "To be verified".

## Site

- [Home](https://wlreviews.github.io/)
- [About and disclosure](https://wlreviews.github.io/about.html)

## Articles

- [The Complete Noom Guide](https://wlreviews.github.io/noom-guide.html) — Noom in depth: all twelve prices, the 7-day trial, daily lessons and coaching, the food colour system, and who it suits. Published 2026-11-20; prices checked 20 November 2026.
- [WeightWatchers vs Noom: an honest comparison](https://wlreviews.github.io/ww-vs-noom.html) — Hub comparison. Published 2026-11-20; full text live, about 5,350 words, 18 FAQs. Prices and trial terms checked 20 November 2026.
- [Noom vs MyFitnessPal: Behavior Change or Calorie Counting?](https://wlreviews.github.io/noom-vs-myfitnesspal.html) — Two different jobs: Noom teaches habits with daily lessons and a coach; MyFitnessPal counts calories with a tracker. Published 2026-11-22; about 4,310 words, 8 FAQs. Prices checked 22 November 2026.
- [Can You Use Noom Without Exercise? What It Requires](https://wlreviews.github.io/noom-without-exercise.html) — One question, answered first: Noom starts with food, not exercise — 200 steps a day is the starting point. Published 2026-11-22; about 2,512 words, 6 FAQs. Facts checked 22 November 2026.
- [Noom Food Color System: Green, Yellow, and Orange Explained](https://wlreviews.github.io/noom-food-color-system.html) — Green, yellow, orange — sorted by calorie density, not good or bad. 30% green, 45% yellow, 25% orange, and no food off limits. Published 2026-11-22; about 2,543 words, 6 FAQs. Facts checked 22 November 2026.
- [What Is Noom Behavior Change? CBT Lessons Explained](https://wlreviews.github.io/noom-behavior-change.html) — Daily CBT lessons, 5–15 minutes: triggers, emotional eating, “head hunger,” plateaus — the method behind the program. Published 2026-11-22; about 2,689 words, 6 FAQs. Facts checked 22 November 2026.
- [What Does a Noom Coach Do? Support, Check-Ins, Limits](https://wlreviews.github.io/noom-coaching.html) — Your coach looks at your food log, suggests foods, and helps through plateaus — included at no extra cost. One-to-one? Not stated. Published 2026-11-22; about 2,383 words, 6 FAQs. Facts checked 22 November 2026.

## Planned articles

- WeightWatchers vs MyFitnessPal: points or free tracking?

## Method

- Each comparison covers three options, judged on the same five points: price and trial terms, daily use, coaching and support, food tracking, cancelling.
- No star ratings. No weight-loss promises. Affiliate disclosure on every page. Adults 18+ only.
